protocol.reward: dt*(existing torso linear+angular tracking -0.01 action-rate sum -10 soft-joint-limit sum)
protocol.termination: smooth height/tilt in imagination; original hard termination in simulation
protocol.selection: highest development return among candidates with unchanged velocity survival
protocol.real_benefit_gate: >0.5% mean return gain; >=2/3 seeds improve; unchanged survival; XY/yaw mean RMSE each <=105% baseline
protocol.recovery: regression observation only, no recovery-task training

limitations: PPO-warm-started offline velocity ablation; no online WM updates, AMP or recovery objective
One training seed; three paired evaluation seeds are not independent training replications
